theme: Twenty-target catalogue with reviewed image relations and source conflicts
question: Can the three evidence passes become a browsable twenty-target register with verified image links, explicit conflicts and ranked missing records?
outcome: Twenty target records consolidate 539 inherited source assertions and two conflict summaries. Fourteen crop-to-catalogue view links are new against the 13 October research index; no newly available pilot photograph or physical merge is established. A separate contributor reviews the image relations, selected primary claims and register structure. Three scoped entries are integrated into the shared data inventory.
challenge: Candidate identities, missing base-family matches, composite crops whose filenames omit panels, conflicting original identifiers and a distinction between index coverage and prior photograph availability.
remedy: Preserve dated versions and candidate sets, compare exact index baselines, reread selected original pages, retain blocked identity claims, independently review source chains and hashes, and render a local catalogue with explicit source coordinates and missing evidence.
retry_when: Obtain registered Dholavira accession-to-catalogue bridges, ASI negative and specimen records for CLXI F, HARP object and photo records for H-2587, original phase arguments for lots 3166 and 8796, or inspect the remaining anonymous crop queue with a frozen selection.
verification_scope: All 14 new image-index relations and selected primary claims; structural and hash checks of inherited metadata. Not an exhaustive primary retranscription or archaeological specialist acceptance.

authors.role: Three production workers and a separate source reviewer

authors.model: GPT-6 family; exact root model identifier not exposed
authors.role: Coordinating contributor, integration review, browser inspection and shared inventory update
